name: Congenital Pulmonary Airway Malformation Type 0

criteria.description: Histopathological identification of abnormal bronchiolar and alveolar structures consistent with type 0 CPAM
Prenatal or postnatal imaging showing diffuse bilateral lung hypoplasia with cystic or solid lesions
Severe neonatal respiratory distress with hypoxemia and cyanosis shortly after birth
Exclusion of other congenital lung malformations such as bronchopulmonary sequestration or other CPAM types

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic histopathology plus compatible imaging findings and clinical presentation of severe neonatal respiratory distress
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Definitive diagnosis often requires histopathological examination after surgical resection or autopsy.

pathognomonic.notes: Observed on imaging and confirmed histologically

searchTerms: cyanosis due to poor oxygen levels

common.notes: Indicative of increased work of breathing
searchTerms: chest wall pulling in during breathing

common.symptomName: Failure to thrive in surviving infants
searchTerms: failure to gain weight or grow

rare.notes: Spontaneous lung collapse due to cyst rupture
Secondary to hypoxia or pulmonary hypertension

laboratory: Arterial blood gas showing hypoxemia and respiratory acidosis
Elevated hematocrit due to chronic hypoxia
imaging: Prenatal ultrasound showing echogenic lung with cystic changes
Chest X-ray showing diffuse bilateral lung opacities and hypoplasia
CT scan demonstrating abnormal airway branching and cystic lesions
genetic: No specific genetic mutation identified; sporadic occurrence
other: Histopathology revealing abnormal bronchiolar and alveolar development with acinar dysplasia

distinguishingFeatures: Localized mass rather than diffuse lung involvement
No abnormal airway branching typical of CPAM

redFlags: Severe respiratory distress unresponsive to conventional therapy
Progressive hypoxemia and cyanosis in neonate
Failure to thrive with recurrent respiratory infections
references: Stocker JT. Congenital Pulmonary Airway Malformation: Classification and Pathology. Semin Pediatr Surg. 2002;11(1):17-23.
Langston C. New concepts in the pathology of congenital lung malformations. Semin Pediatr Surg. 2003;12(1):17-37.
